S.status: 14 cameras surveyed  ·  4 on live CHEKT feeds  ·  open perimeter  ·  single approach  ·  2 recommended positions (dashed, not installed)

items.text: 14 cameras are surveyed (GPS stills, true headings); 4 are on live CHEKT feeds (front door, driveway, upper deck master, lower deck single door).
One approach: the ~88 m private drive from MacAlpine Loop. The drive entry is not covered; the first camera view is the motor court.

confidence.basis: Ruler 87.6 m (88.6 m in the DJI notes); surveyed pins/headings cluster at the court; entry is ~60 m+ beyond a 25 m view
confidence.failure_risk: Foot/ATV approach across open land; a court camera sees part of the drive

items.text: Open perimeter on the W and N (no fence identified) with a dirt track around the sport court; dense conifers on the S and E limit sightlines.

confidence.basis: GE 2024 and the DJI model (7/21/2026) both show open sage W/N and the track
confidence.failure_risk: A low wire/ranch fence not resolvable

items.text: Coverage concentrates on the court frontage and the rear decks / lawn.

confidence.basis: 14 survey pins with headings (true), but FOV/range are default assumptions; only 4 linked to feeds
confidence.failure_risk: Actual views differ from the default wedges

A.title: Access
A.status: Access + emergency response  ·  1 private drive ~88 m (288 ft), ~3.7 m (12 ft) at narrowest  ·  meet at the drive entry  ·  EMS in the motor court  ·  single way out
A.legend:
Yellow = drive (GE ruler, 87.6 m)  ·  Green = motor court
Orange box = large-apparatus staging on MacAlpine Loop
White/red box = ambulance (to scale)  ·  Cyan dashed = on foot
Orange ring = meet / ground-guide point

items.text: Everything arrives by one private drive off MacAlpine Loop: 87.6 m (288 ft), curved, ~3.7 m (12 ft) at its narrowest, trees close on both sides, no pullouts visible.
Meet / ground-guide at the drive entry on MacAlpine Loop. Engines and ladders stage on the loop; no LZ on the parcel (dense canopy).

confidence.basis: Drive 3.7–3.8 m wide (ruler) supports staging on the loop. 'Dense canopy' is overstated: W/N is open sage with scattered trees in both GE and DJI
confidence.failure_risk: Agency would use open ground W/N or the loop as an LZ

items.text: The paved motor court (~20-25 m) takes an ambulance with a multi-point turn; patient path is front entry (probable) to the court.

confidence.basis: Court not ruler-measured (GE notes #4); my scale-bar read puts paved area ~25–30 m. Entry supported by the FRONT DOOR camera and the 'Front walkway' pin on the court side
confidence.failure_risk: Parked cars cut turning room; entry elsewhere

items.confirm_by: Earth ruler line on court; site visit

items.text: Rear yard on foot via the W side of the house to the N lawn, 50.4 m (165 ft). There is no walk-around on the S/E. The drive is the only way out.

confidence.basis: Ruler 50.4 m (51.8 m DJI notes). S/E judged blocked by trees; the ~2.5 m step is from an elevation profile only
confidence.failure_risk: E side passable via lawn/pool deck; step is a 3D artifact

items.text: Back the ambulance up the drive or turn it in the court before loading; keep the drive clear of parked apparatus so the single exit stays open.

confidence.basis: Single paved drive confirmed in GE and DJI

items.text: Ground-guide large apparatus from the drive entry; agree an LZ with the agency in advance.

confidence.basis: Narrow 3.7–3.8 m drive (ruler) is below the 20 ft fire-access norm

items.text: Confirm the front-entry location, any gate at the drive entry, and the ~2.5 m step on the W walk route on a site visit.

confidence.basis: Verification ask

items.text: Add a Knox box / lockbox if none exists (none identifiable in imagery) and post the address number at the drive entry.

confidence.basis: Rule of thumb; neither is visible from overhead

items.text: Native ponderosa, juniper and sagebrush surround the parcel; canopy comes within a few metres of the roofline on the S, SE and NW.
The irrigated N and E lawns are the only cleared buffer. The S/SE has no equivalent cleared zone.

confidence.basis: Lawns N/E clear in GE + DJI. The DJI model also shows lawn by the motor court/S side and the pool deck E (both non-fuel)

items.text: No City of Bend hydrant within 800 m and no pool, pond or tank visible: water must come by tender or drafting.

confidence.basis: Hydrant half: City GIS (only the City layer; other water providers' hydrants are not in it). Pool half is WRONG: the DJI model (7/21/2026) shows a lap pool E/NE by the pergola
confidence.failure_risk: Pool exists (possible draft source); a non-City hydrant may exist
